name: Cascade Hollow Distilling Co. (George Dickel) - Tullahoma TN

fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck entrance. The campus is reached by a single private drive off Cascade Hollow Road; the only barrier is a decorative split-rail fence and a branded welcome sign at the visitor entrance (2024-11 Street View). No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint structure on the truck approach.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth. The buildings near the entrance are the public visitor center.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale resolved in imagery; left false (low confidence).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Loading area on the north face of the production complex - z20 imagery shows ~6 trailers/trucks parked with a gravel staging/turnaround apron. Estimated ~6 doors, band 0-10, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No marked trailer-parking stalls; trailers present are at the active loading apron, not a drop lot.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: production/distillery complex, visitor center, and ~2 single-story sheet-metal rickhouses set in the woods to the southeast.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long wooded private drive (>500 m) from Cascade Hollow Road plus an open internal yard - ample queuing depth.
fieldNotes.staging: Gravel turnaround/staging area on the north side of the production buildings, used by inbound/outbound trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Deep in a wooded hollow in rural Coffee County TN, well outside Tullahoma's developed fabric - Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural and isolated in a forested hollow surrounded by woods; cellular coverage likely weak - inferred, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.general: Per The Spirits Business, production was paused September 2025; the site continues operating for warehousing/maturation, so freight activity is reduced.
